record: Introduced the bipartisan Protecting Kids from Human-Like Chatbots Act.
Introduced the Conversational AI Services Act on chatbot protections for minors.
grade_reason: She has spoken about AI in 2026 (two child-safety bills on chatbots) and 2025 (AI in healthcare), but nothing found acknowledges catastrophic risk.
notes: All 7 web searches ran (none refused). None found any statement by her on superintelligence, extinction or existential risk, a pause, slowdown or moratorium of AI development, an AI agreement with China, or self-improving AI. Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (H.R. 10538, introduced September 2026 by Rep. Casar): no source found showing her as a co-sponsor; the congress.gov cosponsor page returned 403 so the official list was not checked directly; news coverage names only Democratic co-sponsors. Search results on China agreements and extinction were about other people with similar names (Rep. Gregory Meeks, Geoffrey Miller, Jim Miller), not her. Earlier work kept: her press release archive (millermeeks.house.gov/media/press-releases pages 0 to 24, back to May 2024) was scanned by title for AI terms and the four AI-titled releases were opened; release bodies of unrelated releases were not all read. Also seen but not included: 2025-09-23 release backing autonomous AI eye exams for diabetics (D); a Storm Lake Radio report dated 2025-09-04 on an Energy and Commerce chatbot hearing where she called for 'clear standards' for chatbots and spoke about trust in chatbots by age (D, 2025, not included because the three D statements are more substantial). A LessWrong post says she co-sponsored a 'CATS Act'; not verified and not included. Not checked in depth: House floor speeches, full hearing transcripts, interviews.
